## Install

Download the archive for your system, unpack it and plug in the USB stick. Then run one of these in the unpacked folder.

Make a new stick (this erases it):

```
sudo ./stambha
```

Update an existing Stambha stick to v@VERSION@:

```
sudo ./stambha update
```

On Windows, open Terminal with Run as administrator and write `.\stambha.exe` in place of `sudo ./stambha`.

On macOS, stambha is not notarized. If macOS says it cannot be opened, run this once in the unpacked folder:

```
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine stambha
```

Then boot the PC from the stick.

## Changes

## Boot log

If Stambha does not work, save the boot log and include `log.txt` in your report:

```
sudo ./stambha log --output log.txt
```
